2608.03041.title: PLAN: Parallel Liquid-Inspired Approximation Network for Efficient Representation Learning in Flexible Job Shop Scheduling
2608.03041.paper_summary: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) approaches for flexible job shop scheduling (FJSP) heavily rely on attention-centric architectures to achieve state-of-the-art performance. However, these models suffer from excessive parameter counts and prohibitive inference latency as problem scales expand. While liquid neural networks (LNNs) offer a parameter-efficient alternative for modeling adaptive state evolution, their inherently sequential dynamics bottleneck computational efficiency. To resolve this trade-off, we propose PLAN (Parallel Liquid-inspired Approximation Network), a lightweight representation learning framework that reformulates continuous liquid-state dynamics into a discretized and parallelizable formulation. PLAN structurally decouples state evolution from context aggregation, where liquid-inspired updates handle the primary evolving state representation, and a lightweight context aggregation module provides complementary global context. Furthermore, PLAN acts as a versatile, plug-and-play backbone that generalizes to complex FJSP variants, pairing with a compact stochastic module for stochastic FJSP and replacing heavy heterogeneous graph transformers in multi-faceted dynamic FJSP. Extensive evaluations across deterministic, stochastic, and multi-faceted dynamic FJSP benchmarks show that PLAN reduces the average makespan by 1.2%, 1.4%, and 2.3%, respectively, compared with the corresponding state-of-the-art baselines, with the improvement reaching 10.2% in one benchmark setting. PLAN also reduces average inference latency by 13.2%, 31.7%, and 26.9%, respectively, with a maximum reduction of 69.2% on the largest instances, while using only 22$-$47% of the baseline parameters.
2608.03041.paper_summary_zh: 深度強化學習（DRL）方法在靈活作業排程（FJSP）中重度依賴以注意力為中心的架構以達到最先進的性能。<lb/>然而，隨著問題規模的擴大，這些模型面臨著過多的參數數量和高昂的推理延遲。<lb/>雖然液態神經網絡（LNNs）提供了一種參數高效的替代方案來建模自適應狀態演變，但其固有的序列動態限制了計算效率。<lb/>為了解決這一權衡，我們提出了PLAN（平行液態啟發近似網絡），這是一個輕量級的表示學習框架，將連續的液態狀態動態重新定義為離散化和可並行化的形式。<lb/>PLAN在結構上將狀態演變與上下文聚合解耦，其中液態啟發的更新處理主要的演變狀態表示，而輕量級的上下文聚合模塊則提供補充的全局上下文。<lb/>此外，PLAN作為一個多功能的即插即用骨幹，能夠泛化到複雜的FJSP變體，與一個緊湊的隨機模塊配對以處理隨機FJSP，並在多面向動態FJSP中替換重型異質圖Transformer。<lb/>在確定性、隨機性和多面向動態FJSP基準測試中的廣泛評估顯示，與相應的最先進基準相比，PLAN分別減少了平均完工時間1.2%、1.4%和2.3%，在一個基準設置中改善達到10.2%。<lb/>PLAN還分別減少了平均推理延遲13.2%、31.7%和26.9%，在最大實例上減少幅度達69.2%，同時僅使用基準參數的22%至47%。
